game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Spider Den, a webbed spider den: the shadow ranger must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Spider Den: a webbed spider den

win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the stone seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
